dinkum-3.meaning: "When your flights actually took off and landed" changes the recommended log points from departures and arrivals to airborne times, which can omit taxi time; the eligibility and forfeiture rules remain intact.
dinkum-3.sense: "put in for travel comp time" and "have a squiz" correctly mean request and consult.
dinkum-3.authenticity: "Give your Timekeeper or an HR Specialist at your agency a shout" is natural Australian informal advice.
dinkum-3.register: "have a squiz" and "put in for" supply a light local touch without crowding out the practical guidance or adding vulgarity.
dinkum-3.tone: "Once you hit the expiry date, you forfeit the leave" keeps the firm employment-rule warning clear.
dinkum-3.flow: "The hours are based on elapsed time, and you work that out using the time zone you left from" is easy spoken explanation.
dinkum-3.variety: "put in for", "have a squiz" and "Give your Timekeeper or an HR Specialist at your agency a shout" offer varied phrasing rather than a recurring tag.
dinkum-3.essence: "### Understanding travel comp time" and "### Using travel comp time" retain the guide's path from eligibility to calculation to expiry.

pre-fix-yarn.meaning: "one year (26 pay periods)" and "the time zone you left from" retain the expiry and elapsed-time calculation instructions, alongside the conditions and links.
pre-fix-yarn.sense: "Have a squiz" fits consulting the fact sheet, and "runs out" accurately means expires.
pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "if you're after more detail" and "we reckon it's worth keeping a log" sound like natural Australian workplace advice.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "Have a squiz" and "we reckon" provide a light Australian presence while the technical rules stay plain, matching level 2.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "Please get in touch with your Timekeeper or an HR Specialist" keeps the helpful, responsible employee-guidance tone.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "any travel comp time you haven't used is gone too: it's forfeited" repeats the same point awkwardly at the close.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "after more detail", "finer points" and "runs out" vary the conversational wording without recurring slang tags.
pre-fix-yarn.essence: "Travel comp time is for “temporary duty,” also known as “TDY” travel" keeps the defining scope and the original step-by-step guide shape.

current.meaning: "Use the departure time zone to calculate that elapsed time" and "you forfeit any unused travel comp time" retain the calculation and departure-from-GSA rules.
current.sense: "have a squiz" correctly invites consulting the linked fact sheet.
current.authenticity: "If you have questions, please get in touch" and "have a squiz" are natural language for an Australian workplace guide.
current.register: "When calculating travel comp time hours" reflects mostly conventional guidance with one local phrase, leaving the level-2 retelling somewhat faint.
current.tone: "Your salary level and schedule type don’t limit your ability to earn travel comp time" keeps the inclusive but factual employment-guidance tone.
current.flow: "for further details to work out the breakdown of their hours" is a somewhat tangled purpose phrase within otherwise clean writing.
current.variety: "counts as", "acts as" and "get in touch" vary the plain verbs and avoid repeated tics.

dinkum-3.quote: When your flights actually took off and landed
dinkum-3.original: When your flights actually departed and arrived
dinkum-3.why: Takeoff and landing can exclude taxi time included in departure and arrival, which matters in a guide to logging compensable elapsed travel time.

pre-fix-yarn.quote: any travel comp time you haven't used is gone too: it's forfeited
pre-fix-yarn.original: any unused travel comp time will be forfeited
pre-fix-yarn.why: The final explanatory repetition is unnecessary and less fluent.

current.quote: for further details to work out the breakdown of their hours
current.original: to determine the breakdown of your hours
current.why: The two purpose phrases make the linked-resource sentence less smooth.

current.quote: When calculating travel comp time hours, travel ends when you check in at the hotel or arrive home.
current.original: For calculating travel comp time hours, travel ends when you check in at the hotel or arrive home.
current.why: The mainly standard wording makes the requested light Australian vernacular very faint beyond squiz.

summaries.dinkum-3: A natural, well-pitched light Australian guide with intact rules and structure, but its flight log wording risks changing the hours employees record.
summaries.pre-fix-yarn: The strongest combination of factual precision and light local voice here, with only a redundant final phrase.
summaries.current: A faithful and responsible plain-English guide with a natural local touch, though lighter than requested and slightly clumsy around one resource link.
